guide_summary: Output_probability is the verified chance/weight for each possible output. Output_pool is the eligible output set or rule/collection pool for the output. Fee/slippage/liquidity policy is the execution-cost and market-friction policy for all 7 reviewed rows. These can only be derived from trade-up rule/source evidence or explicit user/source confirmation. Official EV remains blocked until all 9 values are provided, reviewed, and applied under later gates.
